description: P29 writes stages 1-4 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, decisions 25-26); P36 adds stages 5-8 (grow6, moot, champion, throne). It starts once the prologue is done (slice.completed: after the crown, or from world_start when the title skips the prologue) and leads the tracker from then on (Quests makes it the main quest). Through the Kings' Door onto the Kingsgate shelf, relight the beacon the toll-riders hold (the beacon's interaction, once their scouts are cleared: XP floored at level 7), grow to stage 4 at the Kingsgate shrine, then win the oaths of two of the three powers - Brannock, the Greywood and Aldmere - in any order (XP floored at level 11). The oaths stage shows the three powers' meeting places as leads (Brannock's green, Hollowmere's green, the war camp's edge), each until its own oath is won (markers_done_when: M7 polish). P36: after the oaths, grow to stage 6 at the Standing Stones (the Stones' gift: 1 titan iron; M8 gate, F29: below stage 6 the Giant's Stair refuses the giant, so the stage's lead points a giant that is not yet up in the Stonehold at the Ironway's waystone, 'by the Ironway', and its waiting text says so), climb the Giant's Stair and enter the Moot (world.area.moot), settle the clans' champion - Harrok's honour duel (spared or slain) or the talk ending (yielded_talk) - and take the Stone Throne (world.throne.claimed): campaign.completed, the campaign's end screen ("The Giant King") and free roaming after it. XP: grow6 100, moot 100, champion 300, throne 200 (plan §5.8).

stages.objective: Step through the Kings' Door behind the crown altar

stages.waiting_text: Toll-rider scouts hold the beacon hill: drive them off, then light it.

stages.objective: Win the oaths of two of the three powers of the Old Kingdom
stages.waiting_text: Win two of the three oaths: Brannock's (Marchwarden Edda), the Greywood's (Sedge at Hollowmere) and the crown's (Aldmere's herald at the war camp).

stages.objective: Grow to stage 6 at the Standing Stones
stages.waiting_text: The Shrine of the Standing Stones grows a giant to stage 6 once two oaths are won. Below stage 6 the Giant's Stair will not take you: go round by the Ironway, up from Aldmere's road.

stages.objective: Climb the Giant's Stair and enter the Moot
stages.waiting_text: The Giant's Stair climbs from the Mere's north shore to the highlands; the Moot's ring lies north-west of the Stair's head. Beware the toll-riders' battery on the plateau road.

stages.objective: Settle the clans' champion: face Harrok the Unbowed in the Moot's ring
stages.waiting_text: Harrok waits in the ring: step inside and the honour duel begins - break his guard until he kneels, then spare or strike him. His challenge stone by the gate answers first.
